description: Estimate the Aeroplan points and Status Qualifying Credits (SQC) an Air Canada-ticketed (014) fare earns. Points = fare in CAD x status multiplier (Member 1 to Super Elite 6); SQC = fare x 2 (Standard), x 4 (Flex, Comfort, Latitude, Premium Economy, Business), 0 (Basic). Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in CAD, not US dollars. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Air Canada's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare brand. BA = Basic (no SQC); ST = Standard (2 SQC per C$1); FL = Flex (4 SQC per C$1); CO = Comfort (4 SQC per C$1); LA = Latitude (4 SQC per C$1); PE = Premium Economy (4 SQC per C$1); BU = Business (4 SQC per C$1). Basic earns points but no SQC. Standard earns 2 SQC per C$1; Flex, Comfort, Latitude, Premium Economy and Business earn 4.

price.description: Fare paid for the whole ticket (CAD) in CAD. Base fare plus carrier-imposed surcharges, in Canadian dollars, without government taxes and airport fees. If you paid in another currency, Air Canada converts it to CAD at an industry-standard rate. Required unless creditTo is given.

sqc.description: SQC you have so far this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next status.

status.description: Your Aeroplan status when you fly. M = Member (1x points); 25K = 25K (2x points); 35K = 35K (3x points); 50K = 50K (4x points); 75K = 75K (5x points); SE = Super Elite (6x points). Your status multiplies the points (not the SQC).
